data.seoTitle: Notice of Removal of Margin Trading Pairs - 2026-09-03
data.seoDesc:
Binance Margin will delist the following margin trading pairs at 2026-09-03 06:00 (UTC). 
Cross Margin Pairs: TNSR/USDC, SXT/USDC, TURTLE/USDC, AIXBT/USDC, BREV/USDC
Isolated Margin Pairs: TNSR/USDC
